An '''agent''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered the location of a [[Unidentified Carosi XII base|New Republic base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carosi XII]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] reign. The [[Spy/Legends|spy]] trained [[rinacat]]s to perform guerrilla strikes on the base.
